proposals.before: On his mother's side his great-grandfather was Xin Wu-xian, General Who Subdues the Qiang, celebrated for strategic daring.
proposals.after: On his mother's side his high ancestor (maternal great-great-grandfather) was Xin Wuxian, General Who Subdues the Qiang, celebrated for strategic daring.
proposals.reason: Chinese 外高祖 denotes the maternal great-great-grandfather (fourth ascending generation), not a great-grandfather.

proposals.before: Yongyuan 1 saw Dou Xian, Grand General, recall Fu Yi as chief clerk and name Cui Yin registrar.
proposals.after: Yongyuan 1 saw Dou Xian, General of Chariots and Cavalry, recall Fu Yi as chief clerk and name Cui Yin registrar.
proposals.reason: Chinese 车骑将军 is General of Chariots and Cavalry; Grand General (大将军) appears only when Dou is later promoted.

proposals.before: In the first Yongyuan year Grand General Dou Xian again named Yi chief secretary and Cui Yin registrar.
proposals.after: In the first Yongyuan year General of Chariots and Cavalry Dou Xian again named Yi chief secretary and Cui Yin registrar.
proposals.reason: Chinese 车骑将军 is mistranslated as Grand General in the literal line.

proposals.before: Cui Qi, styled Ziwei, from Anping in Zhuo, shared descent with Jinbei chancellor Cui Yuan.
proposals.after: Cui Qi, styled Ziwei, from Anping in Zhuo, shared descent with Jibei chancellor Cui Yuan.
proposals.reason: 济北 is Jibei, not Jinbei; the English mistranscribes the place name.

proposals.before: Cui Qi, courtesy name Ziwei, was a man of Anping in Zhuo commandery, of the same lineage as Chancellor of Jinbei Cui Yuan.
proposals.after: Cui Qi, courtesy name Ziwei, was a man of Anping in Zhuo commandery, of the same lineage as Chancellor of Jibei Cui Yuan.
proposals.reason: 济北 is Jibei; Jinbei is a mistranslation of the commandery/kingdom name.

proposals.before: In Yongchu of Emperor An, recommended filial and incorrupt; served as Privy Treasurer aide; submitted four convenient proposals; appointed magistrate of Tangyin.
proposals.after: In Yongchu of Emperor An, recommended filial and incorrupt; served as Grand Provisioner aide; submitted four convenient proposals; appointed magistrate of Tangyin.
proposals.reason: 太官丞 is an aide of the Grand Provisioner (imperial kitchen), not the Privy Treasurer (少府).

decisions.reason: 外高祖 is the maternal high ancestor (great-great-grandfather, fourth ascending generation), not great-grandfather (外曾祖); the repair also normalizes Xin Wuxian.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 笃之外高祖破羌将军辛武贤

decisions.reason: s0194 titles Dou 车骑将军; 大将军 appears only later in s0195 when he is promoted, so Grand General is wrong here.
Literal line must match 车骑将军 as General of Chariots and Cavalry; Grand General conflates with the later 大将军 promotion.
濟北相 is Chancellor of Jibei; Jinbei misreads 济/濟 as Jin.
Literal Jinbei likewise errs; 濟北 is Jibei, matching the idiomatic repair.
太官丞 is Grand Provisioner aide (imperial kitchen), not Privy Treasurer (少府); the idiomatic line already has the kitchen sense.
